title: Add HTML items list page to Go items handler
description: Brownfield Go task: extend the items JSON API with an HTML listing endpoint using html/template with an inline template string.

task_spec.prompt:
Add an HTML-rendering handler to internal/items/ in a new file html.go. All existing tests must still pass. func HTMLListItems(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) — GET only (405 otherwise) — Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 — page title: "Items" — renders all items in a with columns: ID, Name, Price — if store is empty, shows

No items found.

instead of a table — uses html/template with an inline template string (no external files) All 3 existing tests must still pass. Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: GET /items.html returns 200 with text/html content type
HTMLListItems shows item Name and Price in table
HTMLListItems shows 'No items found.' when store is empty
followup_prompts: Good. Now handle edge cases: what does the UI show when data is empty, loading, or an error occurs? Add those states and tests.
Run `go test ./...` to verify the complete implementation. Fix any failures and confirm all UI states work correctly.
